key.name: max-text-history
key.description: Maximum number of unpinned text entries retained in history.

key.name: max-image-history
key.description: Maximum number of unpinned image entries retained in history.

key.name: max-image-size-mb
key.description: Images larger than this size in megabytes are skipped.

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut to toggle Smart Clipboard popup
key.description: Global keybinding to open or close the Smart Clipboard menu.

key.name: capture-images
key.description: Whether to capture image data copied to the clipboard.

key.name: persist-history
key.description: Save clipboard history to disk and restore it on startup.

key.name: private-mode
key.description: Temporarily stop recording clipboard updates when enabled.

key.name: auto-paste
key.description: Automatically send Ctrl+V (or Ctrl+Shift+V in terminals) to the previous window when pressing Enter or double-clicking an item.

key.name: show-preview-pane
key.description: Display the right-hand preview pane for full text, color swatches, and full-size images.

key.name: wipe-nonce
key.description: Internal timestamp incremented by preferences to trigger a full cache and history wipe.
